Supply included: 88% Feeder Cattle (52% Steers, 1% Dairy Steers, 46% Heifers, 1% Bulls); 9% Slaughter Cattle (4% Steers, 1% Heifers, 87% Cows, 9% Bulls); 3% Replacement Cattle (35% Stock Cows, 47% Bred Cows, 3% Bred Heifers, 15% Cow-Calf Pairs, 0% Bulls). Feeder cattle supply over 600 lbs was 62%.
